text:
natalie_support: Support -> CS handoff for HelixBio. New trial org failing onboarding: embeddings similarity drifted (~18% lower) after model swap and bulk ingest returns sporadic 429/timeout. Trial activation fell from 62% -> 33%. Renewal/contact cadence: sales follow-up in 6 days. Need CS bridge + enablement and a short customer-facing note.

omar_se: Seen it. The model swap to v3-quant appears to have changed tokenizer behavior for their docs, causing shorter effective context and mismatch. Bulk ingest worker saturation also hitting transient 429s. I've applied a temporary tenant-specific throttle and queued a config rollback to v2-compat. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/7429

lina_csm: I'll own the customer communication and bridge. Can we get a one-paragraph RCA I can share on the call? I'll schedule a 45m bridge at 11am ET. @devon_csm_lead FYI - if we can't stabilize before the sales touch, we may need renewal mitigation.

devon_csm_lead: Acknowledged. Prepare renewal mitigation checklist: (1) offer one week free trial extension, (2) single exec outreach if >48h downtime, (3) prioritize a dedicated enablement session. Lina, please capture customer sentiment and ask for specific pain points during the bridge.

omar_se: Quick customer-facing line: "We're rolling back a recent model compatibility change for your tenant and applying a temporary ingest throttle. Expect improvements within 45 minutes; we'll review results live on the bridge."

natalie_support: Pushed logs to the thread and added the error snippets. Short extract for the call: `ingest_worker::429 "rate_limit_exceeded" at 2026-03-24T09:12:03Z` and `embed_sim: baseline 0.88 -> 0.72 after v3-quant`.

incidents_bot: Incident 7429 created. Priority: P2 -> CS escalation. Bridge scheduled: 2026-03-24T11:00:00-04:00. Eng oncall looped.

lina_csm: Thanks. Owners for comms: immediate customer ping = Lina, tech RCA on call = Omar + Natalie, post-call remediation plan = Devon. Also capture ask: do they want a ZIP of migrated embeddings for audit?

devon_csm_lead: Add enablement session owner: Lina + Solutions Eng. Also: capture feedback via this quick survey after the bridge: `https://redwood.feedback/s/helix-onboard` — ask customer to rate onboarding friction. We'll attach results to renewal play.

omar_se: Rollback snippet for runbook: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal/api/admin/tenants/rollback -d '{"tenant":"helixbio","target":"v2-compat"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

natalie_support: Invite sent to Helix contact, Lina, Devon, Omar. I'll join early to stream logs. Sync 15m prior.

lina_csm: Perfect. After the bridge I'll update the renewal risk flag and the recommended credits. Also will include a short timeline and requested follow-ups (embedding export, enablement session, postmortem). :raised_hands:
